_comment: The Ask page's brain, as DATA. The configured judge LLM answers a
question about the person's own sessions by calling the read-only
tools listed here, one per step, and then answering from what it
found. `prompt_template` is rendered once per step with {tools},
the model reads; the Python side binds each name to a read function
and rejects any argument not listed under `args`.
examples: Which of my sessions had the most tool errors, and what went wrong in the worst one?
What did I work on last week, project by project?
Which tools fail most across all sessions?
Find the sessions where I asked about pytest fixtures.
What does the coaching analysis say I should change in how I prompt?
Which sessions are most similar to my longest session, and why?

tools.name: find_sessions
tools.purpose: List sessions, newest first, filtered by a project or model keyword, a copilot, a date range or a tag, sorted by one column. Use it to find session ids before asking about one session.

args.query: keyword matched against project path and model (optional)
args.sort: started_at | turn_count | tool_call_count | error_count | cost_usd | duration_seconds (default started_at)

tools.name: session_summary
tools.purpose: Facts about one session: project, model, turns, tools used with counts, errors, response-time percentiles, which analyses exist. Cheap; call it before reading turns.

args.session_id: the numeric session id from find_sessions

tools.name: session_turns
tools.purpose: Read a window of one session's turns as text. EVERY session has this: each turn keeps a preview (its first few hundred characters), and projects that opted into archiving keep the full text. Tools called and errors are marked per turn. Use from_turn/count to page through a long session.

tools.name: session_analyses
tools.purpose: The stored LLM analyses of one session: harness tuning findings, prompt coaching, efficiency levers. Empty when the person has not run them.

tools.name: search_text
tools.purpose: Full-text search of what was said in every session — the turn previews every session keeps, plus full archived text where a project opted in. Returns session ids, turn numbers and snippets.

tools.name: patterns
tools.purpose: Aggregates across sessions: tools by calls and errors, error types by count. Optionally within one workspace path or for one tool.

tools.name: similar_sessions
tools.purpose: Sessions most similar to one session by meaning (from the similarity pass), with scores and what they share (tools, error types, files, project).

tools.name: graph_question
tools.purpose: Run one question from the knowledge-graph catalogue by id (the list of ids and their parameters is under FACTS). Answers cross-session questions the other tools cannot: tools that precede errors, files touched by the most sessions, similar sessions across projects.

args.params: object of parameter name to value, e.g. {"session": "claude-code:abc"} or {"project": "/path"}

tools.name: overview
tools.purpose: Store-wide totals: sessions, turns, tool calls, errors, cost, sessions per copilot, top tools. Use for 'how much' questions with no session in mind.

force_answer_note: You have used every step you had. Answer NOW from what is above, saying what you could not check.
bad_json_note: Your previous reply was not a single JSON object. Reply with exactly one JSON object of the two shapes given.
